Nadia R: hi @jordan_people_ops 11 quick question: Im experiencing increased social anxiety thats been triggered by back-to-back panel interviews. my provider suggested avoiding large panel-style interviewing for about 3 months. can hiring ops reassign live panel duties and let me do take-home assessments or 1:1 interviews instead?

Jordan (People Ops): thanks for reaching out, Nadia. we can start the interactive process. high-level provider notes are fine. in the meantime, what parts of interviewing feel most triggering?

Nadia R: the panel Q&A and the requirement to run the candidate debriefs immediately after. the public note-taking makes me anxious. i can do technical homework grading, one-on-one technical interviews, and structured rubrics instead.

Eve (Hiring Ops): thanks for the specifics. we try to be flexible for accommodations. hiring ops can reassign panel moderator responsibilities for 8-12 weeks and provide alternative routes (take-home tasks, recorded videos, 1:1 interviews). well need a manager sign-off for reassignments.

Sam (Eng Manager): Sam here. happy to redistribute panel slots across the team. Nadia, would you be comfortable taking an asynchronous coding task review instead of panel moderating?

Nadia R: yes, async review and 1:1s are fine. also if notes need to be taken by someone else that would help.

Jordan (People Ops): proposed temporary accommodation plan:
- reassign panel moderator duties for 12 weeks
- allow alternative interview formats: take-home tasks, recorded walkthroughs, or 1:1 interviews
- delegate debrief note-taking to a teammate during this period
- 30-day check-in with manager + people-ops
confidentiality: details limited to manager + hiring ops + those covering duties.

Interview Bot: Created scheduling poll: options 2005001260 / 2005001300 / 2005001360. use /pick to vote.

Eve (Hiring Ops): voted 2005001300. I'll prepare template rubrics for async tasks and update the interview playbook to include an accommodation flag so interviewers know to avoid panel ownership for Nadia during the window.

Sam (Eng Manager): will update the schedule and ask Jaime and Priya to take on panel slots. Sam votes 2005001300.

Nadia R: thanks everyone. one concern: will this affect my promotion cycle? i had a feedback note pending about interview counts.

Jordan (People Ops): accommodations are protected and shouldn't be used against you. we'll add a short success checklist for the 30-day review to capture outcomes (quality of async feedback, number of interviews completed via alternative routes). promotion criteria remain performance-based and reasonable accommodations will be noted but not punitive.

Eve (Hiring Ops): action items: Eve to update playbook + templates, Sam to reassign panel slots, Jordan to send secure link if provider docs are needed, schedule the intake meeting after poll.

Nadia R: appreciated. will upload the note if needed and thanks for the quick help. :relieved:
